title: Explicit phone-to-PC investigation handoff
$comment: Runtime validators enforce a256KiB UTF8document limit and all evidence/report budgets. Sending is explicit and requires an approved active phone bridge. The bundle may contain one reviewed saved still; no full recording, provider configuration or APIkey is part of the handoff. An optional report is re-grounded against submitted IDs and its QA section is re-derived. PC reception stores a bounded memory preview; saving and model analysis each require a separate user action.
